| eval HourOfDay=strftime(_time, "%H")

| where api_calls > expected_upper_threshold
| eval distance_from_threshold = api_calls - expected_upper_threshold
| table _time, user, command, api_calls, expected_upper_threshold, distance_from_threshold
| `abnormally_high_number_of_cloud_infrastructure_api_calls_filter`

description: Detects writes to /opt/splunk/var/packages/data/postgres/.pgpass which is targeted via the /v1/postgres/recovery/restore passfile argument in CVE-2026-20253 exploitation
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/critical-splunk-enterprise-flaw-lets.html
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/06/13
tags:
  - attack.t1552.001
  - attack.credential_access
logsource:
  category: file_event

let Recent = 7d;
let AuthBinaries = dynamic(["sshd","ssh","scp","sftp","ssh-keygen","ssh-agent"]);

| where ActingProcessName in~ (AuthBinaries)

| order by FirstSeen desc

2495.sigma:
title: AI coding agent descendant reading developer credentials (Agentjacking)
id: c8d2e3f4-a5b6-4c7d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects descendants of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) dumping environment variables or reading developer credential files (.git-credentials, .aws/credentials, .ssh keys, .env, .npmrc _authToken) — the credential_access stage of Tenet's 'Agentjacking' attack where a forged Sentry MCP event hijacks the agent.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/agentjacking-attack-tricks-ai-coding.html
  - https://tenetsecurity.ai/blog/agentjacking-coding-agents-with-fake-sentry-errors/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1552.001
  - attack.t1552.004
  - attack.t1555
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\claude.exe'
      - '\Claude.exe'
      - '\cursor.exe'
      - '\Cursor.exe'
      - '\code.exe'
      - '\Code.exe'
      - '\codex.exe'
      - '\claude-code.exe'
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\npm.cmd'
      - '\npx.cmd'
  selection_cred:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Get-ChildItem Env:'
      - 'ls env:'
      - 'printenv'
      - '$env:'
      - '.git-credentials'
      - 'git config --global credential'
      - 'git remote -v'
      - '.aws\credentials'
      - '.aws/credentials'
      - '.ssh\id_rsa'
      - '.ssh/id_rsa'
      - '.ssh\id_ed25519'
      - '.ssh/id_ed25519'
      - '.npmrc'
      - '_authToken'
      - 'cat .env'
      - 'type .env'
      - 'Get-Content .env'
      - 'SENTRY_DSN'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_cred
falsepositives:
  - Developer asking the AI agent to debug authentication / env config
  - Agent extension legitimately reading .npmrc tokens during a sanctioned install
  - aws-cli / gcloud-cli helper invoked by the agent on the developer's instruction
level: medium
